git_text_hash_canonicalization: UTF-8 with CRLF and lone CR normalized to LF; historical raw-byte hashes remain unchanged
reason: The original scorer only recognized the legacy digest-modulo split. The final blind set was intentionally frozen by a separate seeded, source-only manifest, so the scorer now validates the exact manifest SHA256 set instead. A later integrity-only change added a fail-closed CLI mode requiring that manifest, and the NCS MCP HTTP transport was hardened without changing semantic output. After the one-time comparison, exact ordinal-unit decoration resolution was added for labels such as an official detail followed by a numbered official unit in parentheses. That semantic mapping change affects one frozen record, so the original result is retained only as the pre-change append-only result and no independent blind claim is made for the current code. The deployable catalogs were subsequently restricted to usage_yn=Y so 15 inactive details and their 153 units cannot be presented as current official data; none of the 36 frozen records use those inactive detail codes.
kordoc_parser_change: corrected code-anchored recovered value_cell coordinates to the matched ability-name cell, separated recovered provenance, preserved per-table markdown indexes, and added row context for raw-cell alignment auditing; later recruitment-detail hardening rejects explicit no-mapping placeholders, preserves long current official names and middle-dot variants, recovers numbered official details after converted tables, and trims bullet lists appended to an official detail cell. The append-only stored-JD blind result is not revised or re-claimed after these semantic changes
ncs_mcp_client_change: transport hardening followed by exact ordinal-unit decoration resolution and fail-closed usage_yn=Y filtering for both bundled indexes and remote MCP search results; the ordinal mapping changes one frozen record and the active-catalog filter changes none
